answer: Bond what votes. Every claim to weight must sit on a lock of POA - a pearl posted into escrow - while a sybil farm's real weakness is that the farmer's treasury sits behind it. Split the bond across a thousand accounts and each thins toward irrelevance; pool one treasury and its signatures form a thread of correlated timing the scorer flags for slashing. Unslashed rewards then release glacier-slow over 100 epochs, so N fake voters mean N months of capturable capital, not N cheap keys.
